Subject: Quick pricing check — per-1M token (input/output) + model list

Hi Vanessa,

We're evaluating hosted inference vendors for a prototype (BrightPath AI). Before scheduling a deeper call, can you send your standard per-1M token pricing split by input vs output? Also we'd like a short list of the models that are included in the \"standard\" hosted tier (i.e., compatible with the baseline IO rates).

A few extra details that would help:
- Expected ramp: 2M tokens/month in pilot and ~12M/month in production.
- Any volume breakpoints (10M, 50M) and the delta to rate?
- Do embeddings use a separate unit/price?

If you have a one-pager or ratecard PDF you can attach, that would be great.

Thanks,
Ethan

Ethan —

Thanks for the note and the ramp context. I attached our current hosted ratecard (PDF) — highlights below for quick scanning:

- Standard hosted IO rates (per 1M tokens):
  - Input tokens: $0.40 / 1M
  - Output tokens: $0.80 / 1M
- Embeddings: priced separately at $1.25 / 1M embedding tokens (different unit, listed on page 3 of the PDF).
- Volume breakpoints: 10M/month — 10% off list; 50M/month — 22% off list.
- Models included in the standard hosted tier: redwood-1-base, redwood-1-medium, gptj-6b-open, mistral-mini.
  - Larger/experimental families (redwood-1-large, optx-xxl) are available but priced at a premium or require eligibility for the Dedicated tier.

If BrightPath expects to commit to a steady 12M/mo over 12 months, typical motion is a committed discount (we can discuss 10–15% depending on term). If you'd like, I can put together a short quote and suggested MAP showing monthly spend and the committed discount tiers.

Would you prefer a quick 30-minute call to walk through the PDF and discuss model fit, or should I send a draft quote first?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0199

Thanks Vanessa — that helped a lot. A couple follow-ups: 

1) Do the volume discounts apply retroactively each month or only to committed volumes? For our procurement team it's important to understand whether we need a firm commitment or whether we can operate month-to-month and receive the breakpoint pricing.
2) For the model roster, can you confirm whether redwood-1-medium supports streaming responses and function/tool calling (we plan to stream partial outputs to users)?
3) We're also evaluating a Dedicated capacity conversation later; for the pilot we want the hosted option but want visibility on how easily we can move to Dedicated and whether committed credits convert.

I've attached a rough projected volume sheet (BrightPath_volume_estimate.xlsx) — pilot months are low, then ramp to ~15M/mo in month 6.

If it's easier, send a short quote for the 12-month commitment and a separate month-to-month sketch so we can show both to procurement.

Appreciate it,
Ethan

Questions for review:
- Recommended public-facing approach: for a 12-month 12M/mo commit, are we comfortable with 10% off list (volume breakpoint at 10M)? If so, I can draft a quote.
- Do we want to include redwood-1-base + redwood-1-medium in the \"standard tier\" eligibility in the quote and mark redwood-1-large as premium (requires a brief model-fit call)?
- Any legal/finance flags on converting hosted credits to Dedicated credits later? I think we can offer conversion at a 1:1 credit basis but would like confirmation.

Suggested reply (short): include 1) month-to-month list pricing, 2) 12-month committed quote with 10% discount for >=10M/mo, 3) short note that larger models are premium/eligibility-gated, and 4) offer a 30-minute call this week to walk through model fit/streaming.

If you approve, I'll send both quote sketches and set a calendar for Friday.

Thanks,
Vanessa
